notes: The macOS 27 SDK adds typed AppKit messages such as NSWindow.DidBecomeKeyMessage (a NotificationCenter.MainActorMessage) with the identifier .didBecomeKey; MacOSX26.5.sdk has none of these NSWindow messages. NotificationCenter.addObserver(of:for:using:) returns an ObservationToken; the name-based addObserver(forName:object:queue:using:) returns NSObjectProtocol.
